note: Notice source registry (N5). Every emit site carries `// notice: <id>`; the id is registered here with its trigger, its destination (action), whether it sounds, and where the user switches it off. switch "none" is called out by the Supervisor.

page-download-saved.area: page: toastManager.js 'melaton:download' saved (a file the Android app saved for her): WM notification on the phone, Vista tray balloon on the desktop / DeX
page-download-saved.action: phone: Open; desktop / DeX: a click on the balloon (window.AndroidNotification.openDownload: the only way from here to the saved file)
page-download-saved.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Other notifications > Display message on screen; desktop / DeX: Taskbar and Start Menu Properties > Notification Area > Customize Notifications > Downloads (trayRegistry popup 'download-saved')
page-download-saved.note: #1321: replaces the app's Android download notification. Silent. One at a time, the newest replaces it (N9).

page-download-failed.area: page: toastManager.js 'melaton:download' failed, her Save did not happen
page-download-failed.action: none: the notice is the failure in words
page-download-failed.sound: by the toast policy: the desktop message box is silent; the phone's Errors event (its Sounds & Notifications setting)
page-download-failed.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Errors; desktop / DeX: none
page-download-failed.note: #1321: replaces the app's Android 'Save failed' notification. An error that stopped her own action, told once per download id (N6, N10).

page-download-open-failed.area: page: toastManager.js, Open on a saved download opened nothing
page-download-open-failed.action: none: the notice is the failure in words
page-download-open-failed.sound: by the toast policy: the desktop message box is silent; the phone's Errors event
page-download-open-failed.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Errors; desktop / DeX: none
page-download-open-failed.note: #1321. Only after her own tap on Open.

device-remove.area: phone and desktop: Device Center's 'End a partnership' and 'Remove this device' confirmation (apps/activesync/client/activesync.js)
device-remove.trigger: user-action (the same task chosen in Device Center's Device Tasks pane)
device-remove.action: the dialog's own buttons - End partnership / Remove runs the removal through activeSync, Cancel does nothing
device-remove.switch: phone: Settings > Sounds & Notifications > Notifications > Questions (its sound and Display message on screen), or Sounds & Notifications > Off; desktop and DeX: Personalization > Sounds (the message box beep) or the sound scheme
device-remove.note: A destructive action asks first, in words, once (N10). This is also the way a device that was never set up leaves the list at all (#1299). No device that connects or leaves announces itself (N11, N2).
